events.summary: Kytheon's own thrown spear killed his friends.
events.quote: The spear thrown by Kytheon's own hand was the weapon that felled his friends.

events.summary: Sorin had to end Avacyn, whom he had created.
events.quote: it fell upon him to end her forever

events.summary: Extus began his research in Blood Age magic that Strixhaven forbade.
events.quote: Strixhaven forbade all magic from the Blood Age, so that is where Extus began his research.

events.summary: Ennor, cast out of Garenbrig, used fae magic to make a weapon for revenge.
events.quote: Cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes, Ennor turned to fae magic to fashion the perfect weapon for his revenge.

relations.quote: When your father is Dean Embrose, second best really isn't an option.
